Assurance regime; jurisdiction International/US

Nuclear safety and safeguards

Two precedents: separating promotion from regulation (AEC split in 1974), and industry-funded confidential peer review that works because insurance and a public regulator sit behind it.

Licensees pay NRC fees; resident inspectors sit on site; INPO peer reviews stay confidential and are tied to insurance.

Payer, access, publication

Who pays. Operators fund INPO; states fund IAEA and national regulators.
Access. IAEA inspections by state consent; Additional Protocol expands access; INPO peer reviews on site.
Publication. INPO reports confidential to the operator and insurers; NRC findings public; IAEA reports to member states.
